spec_theorems.name: run_output_shape
spec_theorems.informal: With the -l slice, execution produces exactly one stdout line.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_bound
spec_theorems.informal: The stdout output has length at most one line.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_content
spec_theorems.informal: The sole output line is the decimal representation of the number of input lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_code
spec_theorems.informal: Successful completion returns exit code zero.

spec_theorems.name: run_idempotent_empty_append
spec_theorems.informal: Appending no input lines does not change the result.
